title: 高架逃逸 · 软着陆
summary: The car leaves the viaduct through the parapet gap with a launch preset (incl. the kerb kick). Use the thrusters to arrive on the street on all four wheels, slowly and level, without a hull strike.
touchdown: first contact of any wheel or hull point with the street (y < 1 m collider or the ground plane) after leaving the deck

reward._doc: Per control step unless marked terminal (spec/README.md section 8). terminal_timeout applies when the horizon ends before a landing (or the car leaves the play area), so hovering until the clock runs out is not a strategy. Implementations must match exactly (parity-tested).
